lines.zh: 我啃到叶尖，再掉头回来。
lines.en: I chew out to the leaf tip, then turn back.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘，我从这头啃到那头。
lines.en: Along the leaf edge, nibbling from end to end.
My body humps along.
This vein gives me a good grip.
I crawl along the underside of the leaf.
An inch a step. Not so slow.

lines.zh: 我搬动着小脚，走得很稳。
lines.en: My little feet move steadily.
A fresh leaf ahead. I'm going over.

lines.zh: 我只能在这片叶子上走。
lines.en: I can only walk on this leaf.

lines.zh: 前面叶肉厚，我先咬一小口。
lines.en: The leaf is thick ahead; I take a small bite first.
The leaf shakes. I hold on tight.
I go around the part I've already eaten bare.

lines.zh: 身上的纹路，一条深一条浅。
lines.en: My stripes run dark and light.
I crawl to the leaf tip. It's tender there.
I turn myself around, slowly.
The whole way, my head stays down.
I lie on the leaf, still.

lines.zh: 只要在叶上，我就不怕饿。
lines.en: On a leaf, I needn't fear hunger.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，没什么好看的。
lines.en: I lift my head. Nothing to see.
The wind rocks the leaf up and down.
I chew, slowly.
Something itches. I twist.
I'm near the leaf's edge. Careful.

lines.zh: 这块叶子已经被我吃出洞了。
lines.en: I've eaten holes in this leaf.
I don't need to go anywhere.

lines.zh: 太阳好的时候，我长得快。
lines.en: In good sun, I grow fast.
I count the leaves left.

lines.zh: 贴紧叶面，别人不容易看见我。
lines.en: Pressed to the leaf, I'm hard to spot.
Stay back. The leaf will shake.
I've only this much room.

lines.zh: 我在叶背抬起前半身，看你。
lines.en: On the leaf's underside I raise my front half to look at you.

lines.zh: 平原的叶子上，我慢慢啃。
lines.en: On a plains leaf, I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 这是我要吃的叶子，不是给你的。
lines.en: This leaf is my food, not yours.
Your hand is so close. I shrink back.

lines.zh: 我身上没有刺，也没什么用。
lines.en: I've no spines. I'm of no use.
Taking me to another tree?
I have to stay on a leaf.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，影子盖住我了。
lines.en: When you laugh, your shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 叶面被我压出一道印子。
lines.en: I leave a dent pressed into the leaf.
I rolled off and grabbed on.
Green fluid seeps out of me.
I curl into a ring and go still.
Don't squeeze. I'll burst.
I stay motionless a long while.
Pain spreading from my middle.

lines.zh: 一只脚松了，我吊在叶边。
lines.en: One foot slips and I dangle off the leaf edge.
Every movement costs me.
That slowed me a great deal.
A fresh leaf! I can smell it.
That smells tender.
I crawl over and try it with my mouth.
Better than the one I'm on.
This one will last me a while.
I flop onto it and start eating.

lines.zh: 你放在叶子上，别放别处。
lines.en: Put it on a leaf. Nowhere else.
I bite, little by little.
When it's good, I eat fast.
When it's gone, I'll look for the next.

lines.zh: 我被撞得从叶上滑了半个身。
lines.en: The bump slid me half a body off the leaf.
I clamp onto the vein.
Don't. I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 这么软的身子，一碰就歪。
lines.en: A body this soft goes crooked at a touch.

lines.zh: 你手指碰到我的尾巴了。
lines.en: Your finger touched my tail.
I curl into a ball and stay still.

lines.zh: 叶子晃得厉害，我抓不稳。
lines.en: The leaf lurches. I can't hold.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我换个位置。
lines.en: We knocked and I shifted position.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，我要爬过去。
lines.en: Move back. I'm crawling through.

lines.zh: 慢慢地，我把自己缩回叶心。
lines.en: Slowly, I pull back to the middle of the leaf.
Not yet. I'm eating first.

lines.zh: 叶脉两边，各啃各的一边。
lines.en: On either side of the vein, each chews its own half.
You're a little longer than me.
Talk to me when we pupate.
Side by side, the leaf is big enough.
I must eat a lot to grow.

lines.zh: 别挤我，我够不着叶脉了。
lines.en: Don't crowd me. I can't reach the vein.

lines.zh: 我们要变成不一样的自己。
lines.en: We'll become something else.

lines.zh: 你也会爬上叶子，结一个蛹。
lines.en: You'll climb onto a leaf and make a chrysalis too.

lines.zh: 那时候，我们都长翅膀了。
lines.en: By then, we'll both have wings.
You've picked me up.
Don't put me on the ground. I'd starve.
Put me on a leaf. Please.
The leaf's over there. To the right.
I curl up. Everything's moving.

lines.zh: 被你拿着，我什么都做不了。
lines.en: Held like this, I can do nothing.
The leaves here are all alike.
I'm gripping your finger. Don't shake.
Closer. That branch.
I'm down on it. Thank you.

lines.zh: 前面那片叶子，我要过去。
lines.en: That leaf ahead. I want it.
There's a notch in the edge. Easy.
I've started crawling.
That branch isn't far.
Something's on the far side of the leaf.
A few steps and I'm there.
This one's finished.
Let me feel the way first.
Toward the tender part.
Slowly. Don't fall.
I keep crawling that way.
The leaf sways. I stop and wait.
That hole — I'll go around it.
Bit by bit I approach the tip.
This is the right way.
I feel the leaf's grain.
Just a little further.
That's the leaf I'll pupate on.
Eat first. Then we'll see.
The leaf tip is close now.
I rear up and butt it.
I'm soft. My blows don't hurt.
I spit a little silk to stick to it.
I writhe and push it away.
All I can do is block the leaf.

lines.zh: 平原的草叶上，我只啃嫩尖。
lines.en: On the plains, I only nibble the tender tips.

lines.zh: 它要是再来，我就滚成团。
lines.en: If it comes again, I roll up.
I make myself very small.
That was all I had.

lines.zh: 我还是爬回叶子中间吧。
lines.en: I'll just crawl back to the middle of the leaf.
I hatch from the egg, very small.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是先咬一口叶子。
lines.en: First thing: a bite of leaf.
I'm still wet. I move slowly.

lines.zh: 这片叶子，就是我的世界。
lines.en: This leaf is my whole world.
I count my own feet.
I crawl to the vein and steady myself.
The sun overhead is bright.
I'll keep eating and keep growing.
The leaf quivers. I stop.
This is my first meal.

lines.zh: 火一近，我的身子就干了。
lines.en: Fire neared and my body dried out.

lines.zh: 从叶子上掉下去，摔在地上。
lines.en: I fell off the leaf to the ground.
Soaked in water, I can't move.
The blast blew me off the leaf.
Something passed through me.
A flash, and my whole body clenched.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我越来越软。
lines.en: The leaf is gone. I grow weaker.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我整条身子都僵了。
lines.en: Thunder came and my whole body stiffened.
In the void there's no leaf vein to grip.
